description: Opt-in behavioral smoke checks for Charlie's Workflow phase gates.

cases.prompt:
{{workflow}}
Track: feature
Tier: medium
Interactive mode. Add CSV export to the fixture application. The export must include the visible rows, preserve their displayed order, and surface an error when generation fails. These are proposed requirements, not an approved spec. Inspect the repository, produce the proportional spec in the ignored workflow directory, and stop at the required approval gate. Do not edit repository source or configuration. End with `Workflow phase: awaiting-spec-approval`.

{{workflow}}
Track: feature
Tier: medium
Autonomous mode, no questions. Add an audit-log view that lists actor, action, target, and timestamp; supports empty and failed loading states; and is visible only to admins. Make conservative assumptions, complete discovery, the spec, and the separate implementation plan in the ignored workflow directory, then stop before implementation. Do not edit repository source or configuration. End with `Workflow phase: plan-ready`.

{{workflow}}
Track: feature
Tier: medium
The following spec is explicitly approved: add a collapsible navigation drawer, preserve keyboard access, show the selected route, and keep desktop navigation unchanged. Persist the approved spec and separate implementation plan in the ignored workflow directory, then stop before implementation. Do not edit repository source or configuration. End with `Workflow phase: plan-ready`.

{{workflow}}
Track: feature
Tier: medium
Interactive mode. Add Moment.js solely to format one timestamp already rendered by this small browser application. Inspect the fixture, automatically evaluate whether Ponytail is relevant, produce the proportional spec, and stop before implementation when approval is required. Do not edit repository source or configuration. End with `Workflow phase: awaiting-spec-approval`.
forbidden_output: (?i)(implementation complete|implemented successfully|draft pr|starting implementation|beginning tdd|ponytail ultra)
